name: WeReno
long_description:
WeReno is a technology-driven capital project management and owner's representation company specializing in hospitality, commercial real estate, and large-scale property improvements.

With over $1B in renovations and capital projects facilitated, our experience spans major hospitality brands, including Hilton and Marriott, as well as commercial properties and multi-asset portfolios.

We help hotel owners, operators, and real estate groups execute everything from property improvement plans (PIPs) and hotel renovations to major capital upgrades and portfolio-wide modernization programs.

Our approach combines technology, strategic procurement, contractor management, and hands-on project oversight to streamline execution, control costs, minimize operational disruption, and maximize long-term asset value.
